question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(DE\parallel BC\), \(AD=2\), \(DB=3\), and \(AE=4\). Find \(EC\). (\(D\) lies on \(AB\), and \(E\) lies on \(AC\).)
solution: Parallel lines divide line segments proportionally, so \(AD/DB=AE/EC\), or \(2/3=4/EC\). Therefore, \(EC=6\).

reference.question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(DE\parallel BC\), \(AD=2\), \(DB=3\), and \(AE=4\). Find \(EC\). (\(D\) lies on \(AB\), and \(E\) lies on \(AC\).)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use proportional segments

Parallel lines divide line segments proportionally, so \(AD/DB=AE/EC\), or \(2/3=4/EC\). Therefore, \(EC=6\).
